name: ai-tool-approval

frames.best_why: Decided trace lines sit above the destructive call with its red badge and Hold to allow button.

tagline: Approve or deny an agent's tool call, or press and hold for a destructive one.
summary: A stack of tool-call cards for an AI agent: each pending call shows the command or fields it wants to run, its reason and Allow or Deny, then folds into a one-line trace as its output streams in.
appearance: Rounded dark cards on black. A pending call shows a tinted tool icon, a title, a monospace tool name, a code or two-column field box, a reason line and a footer with a checkbox, Deny and a white Allow pill; destructive calls swap the pill for a red Hold to allow button and a red Destructive tag.
behaviour: The current call is expanded while earlier ones fold into compact trace lines with a status mark and command. Allowing or denying advances to the next call, holding the red button fills it for about a second before it confirms, and a running call streams output lines that later expand on click.
demo_content: Three sandbox calls: bun test, editing app/checkout/form.tsx, and a destructive rm -rf .next build.
search_phrases: approve or deny an ai tool call
hold to confirm a delete command
allow a terminal command the agent wants
review a tool call before it runs
destructive action needs a long press
use_when: An agent can run shell commands or edit files and each action needs explicit consent.
avoid_when: Trusted, low-risk automation: asking every call, plus a hold for destructive ones, stalls the flow.
customise: The calls array and an onRespond callback are props; tool icons, tints and the hold duration are fixed in the source.
weight_why: A few cards and trace lines; motion runs only on a decision or a streamed output line.

a11y.note: Every action is keyboard reachable, including press and hold, and controls are labelled; the hold fill ignores reduced motion.

props.name: onRespond
props.type: (id: string, approved: boolean, always: boolean) => void

issues: Tool names, reasons and trace text are small and dim on the dark stack.
polish_why: A thoughtful approval flow with a real hold-to-confirm; small grey text is low contrast.
title: AI Tool Approval
